listing.summary: Do you remember Gamma war? Do you remember those silly bol i usually post every where? Now we have an UI which have the same art style!
listing.aiSummary: Reskins the vanilla user interface with a hand-drawn art style inspired by the Gamma war.

description: Changes almost every part of the standard game interface to match a specific hand-drawn aesthetic. It replaces UI elements like cursors and menus, though some changes require manual file replacement in the game directory.
